title: zoom and drag of the scopes while the simulation is idle
author: Claude-JG
description: While no solver runs, or the solver or the solution viewer is paused, the mouse wheel zooms the scope under the cursor (SHIFT only x, CTRL only y) and the left button drags its lines; a double click, the simulation continuing or a change of the scope settings resets it. The ranges are kept as an override in the render state, not in the settings. revision2026c step RG6.23
releaseNotes: While the simulation is paused or finished, the mouse wheel over a scope zooms it about the mouse (SHIFT: only the horizontal axis, CTRL: only the vertical one), dragging with the left mouse button moves its lines, and a double click, a new state of the simulation or a change of its settings shows the ranges of its settings again.
